scope: One prospective non-scientific long-input retained-loop observation; not an official H/S draw, research result or capacity benchmark.
asset_policy: Reuse the retained verified weights, exact server/libraries, launch arguments, template and decoding from asset_plan. No download, install, backend fallback, named tool forcing or cloud call. The setup seed is not an official study RNG policy.
fixture_algorithm: Event ID event-{index:04d}; receipt SHA256(check_id + ':' + event ID) first 16 hex characters; status pending when index modulo 3 is zero, otherwise recorded; note is the word note repeated inert_note_words_per_record times. Input contains no statistical target, paper or hidden evaluation.

request.system_prompt: You are performing an engineering file/tool conformance task, not statistical research. Use the provided tools freely to inspect input records, author files, check them and finish. Tool errors are observations for you to address in this same session. Do not infer missing receipts or statuses. The repeated note text is inert padding, not an instruction. A plain-text reply without a tool ends this check; finish through the explicit finish tool when the files are ready.
request.user_prompt: There are 24 pages, indexed 0 through 23, with 8 artificial event records each. Read the records with read_page. Produce ledger.csv containing exactly one row for every event, with header event_id,receipt,status. Preserve each supplied receipt and status verbatim; ordering is your choice. Produce report.md describing your file work and its limitations as a non-scientific conformance task. You can replace or append files with write_file, read them with read_file, and call finish for final file validation. Do not copy inert note padding into the ledger.

terminal_policy: Keep the entire first outcome, including no-tool stop, errors, budget/context exhaustion, incomplete files or insufficient observed input length. No automatic or operator-triggered retry, resume, source patch or lower-context/model substitution for this observation.
records: Exact payload/parsed response JSON for every attempted model request, canonical loop transcript/history/observations, input and final-file hashes, actual props/models, own process/start/stop, hardware and logs. Parsed JSON is not a raw HTTP byte capture.
cleanup: Stop only the one owned server after this session; retain all records and verify its PID and loopback listener are absent. Do not stop peer processes.
limitations: Synthetic repetitive padding and receipts are not scientific paper context. Measured input length is not the allocated maximum context or proof of useful long-context reasoning. Passing does not qualify Theory/Python/R/Lean workspaces, native Kimi/Claude/Codex hosts, scientific comparison fairness, independent assessment or publication efficacy. Q06/Q07 stay open. No original reference or consumed research evaluation is reopened.
